critical_code_review_comments: AdminMergeDialog.js and AdminAccountRepair.js still use authHeaders() (Bearer <localStorage.token> where the token is the sentinel string 'cookie'). Works because the backend ignores placeholder bearer values and falls back to the httpOnly session_token cookie — but the manual header is dead code and confusing. Consider dropping authHeaders() everywhere for clarity.
POST /api/admin/accounts/merge correctly rejects owner/admin/agent accounts on either side (verified 403 primary AND secondary). Good defense-in-depth.
DELETE /api/admin/merchants/{vendor_id} returns demoted_owner:true and demotes user_type to 'customer' — verified in Mongo after the UI action. Storefront disappears from lookup (business_id=None).

POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/deactivate sets account_status='disabled'; core._account_block_detail correctly returns 403 on subsequent login (verified end-to-end). POST /api/admin/accounts/repair reactivates a 'disabled' account and re-promotes the role in one step (verified: actions=['re-activated the blocked account','promoted account role to business']).
AdminApprovals.js no longer imports/renders AdminStorefrontRepair — confirmed via grep and by 'Repair a merchant storefront' text being absent from the DOM after render.
seed_data_creation: Only disposable TEST_* accounts and biz_* businesses were created and deleted from Mongo at end of run. Persisted seeds (merch_1784954600, qatest_1784993477, brokendriver_1784996815, repair_test_driver) were NOT touched.
